tasks.failure_reason: Perception never localized the middle handle: every find_pixel / find_by_pointing result for the drawer rows landed on the cabinet's front face or the ramp (u≈75-107, v≈126-177), giving inconsistent depths on adjacent pixels (100,132)→z=1.0988 vs (95,126)→z=0.9025; no tool call ever pointed at the visible grey bar handles (u≈143-150, v≈250-330 in the head frame), so pull_drawer approached empty air and reported 'handle pull did not achieve enough measured motion' / 'could not reach the handle approach pose' / 'pixel was not visually verified', and the drawer never opened.
